transcript.t: Ben, would you move to Mars if you could?
But Mars is very cold, and there is no air that people can breathe.
True. We would need special spaceships and suits.
And the trip would take months.
That is fine. I would take books and games on board.
I would miss my family and the blue sky.
Then let's stay on Earth and study space from here.
